settings.title: Playfall tiles
settings.subheading: Cushion dangerous falls and reduce injuries

settings.subtitle: PLAYFALL KITS
settings.title: TILES + EDGING PACKAGES
settings.text:
Introducing Playfall Kits: the complete solution for playground safety surfacing. This convenient package includes tiles and edging, making it easier than ever to create a safe and durable playground surface. Perfect for schools, parks, or backyard play areas.

  •  IPEMA-certified for the highest safety standards
  •  Designed to withstand heavy use while providing fall protection for kids
  •  With simple installation for practical and long term use

settings.title: designed with children's safety in mind

settings.text: The Playfall Mat system consists of the Playfall Tiles and Foam Playpads that are used in conjunction to offer four levels of thicknesses to match the fall heights of even the most extreme play areas.

settings.title: Playfall Tiles
settings.text: These 1.75" thick durable 2' x 2' recycled rubber tiles can be installed over a solid subbase or a well-compacted granular surface. They can be used on their own for 4 ft. fall heights or together with 1" or 2" Playpads for fall heights 6 ft. and higher

settings.title: Foam Playpads
settings.text: Foam Playpads are used in conjunction with Playfall Tiles to increase absorption for fall heights 6 feet and higher. Availabe in 1" and 2" Thicknesses that can be used separately or combined for a total 3" thickness of shock absorption.

settings.title: Playfall Edge Ramps
settings.text: Make transitions to playgrounds smoother and play areas more accessible with Playfall edge ramps. Available in a variety of sizes to match your desired fall height level or existing configuration.
From 4’ to 10’ fall height protection, playfall has the flooring solution for you. our products are designed to meet all safety requirements

settings.title: 4 feet fall height
settings.text:
As children are learning to walk and play, our mat gives them a stable, slip-resistant and protected surface to explore on.

This is also a great option for workout areas that require cushioning, resilience and drop protection.

Configuration: 1.75" Playfall Tiles only

BUY PLAYFALL TILES

settings.title: 6 feet fall height
settings.text:
When kids are playing on (and falling from) lower play structures, this is the perfect flooring option to protect from minor falls.

Our PlayFall Tile combined with our 1″ Playpad surface gives enough support as kids play and jump from a 6’ fall height.

Configuration: 1.75" Playfall Tiles and 1" Playpads

settings.title: 8 feet fall height
settings.text:
For big kids and tall play structures, our intermediate playground flooring option will protect kids as they grow and explore.

Our PlayFall Tile combined with our 2″ Playpad surface gives enough support as kids play and jump from a 8’ fall height.

Configuration: 1.75" Playfall Tiles and 2" Playpads

settings.title: 10 feet fall height
settings.text:
Our thickest PlayFall Tile protects up to 10’ fall height. For the tallest play structures and the most adventurous kids, make sure you’re protecting what matter most.

Our PlayFall Tile combined with our 3″ Playpad surface gives enough support as kids play and jump from a 10’ fall height.

Configuration: 1.75" Playfall Tiles and 1" & 2" Playpads
